fusions.name: Reef Scrape
fusions.desc: Drags the target across branching tines for 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Budding Ring
fusions.desc: Tines of coral bud out from you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Raised Shoal
fusions.desc: Heaps up a reef 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
